firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi @Elan Markowitz,

A quick rules question for the Paper Track.

Part of our experiments needs internet access for the agent (a web search tool via a
public API), so we plan to run that part on a rented cloud GPU instead
of Kaggle's L4 notebooks (which must stay offline). The offline experiments will run on
Kaggle with the official harness and the gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct model.

1. Is running some Paper Track experiments on external cloud GPUs, with internet access,
   acceptable as long as we disclose it in the writeup?
2. The tool may send short search queries (capped length, logged) that can include
   phrases from public open-source issue texts of the dev-set repositories. We don't send
   patches, test patches or the dataset itself. Is that consistent with rule 2.4.b?

Thanks!
firstMessage.content:
Hi @Elan Markowitz,

A quick rules question for the Paper Track.

Part of our experiments needs internet access for the agent (a web search tool via a public API), so we plan to run that part on a rented cloud GPU instead of Kaggle's L4 notebooks (which must stay offline). The offline experiments will run on Kaggle with the official harness and the gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct model.

  1. Is running some Paper Track experiments on external cloud GPUs, with internet access, acceptable as long as we disclose it in the writeup?
  2. The tool may send short search queries (capped length, logged) that can include phrases from public open-source issue texts of the dev-set repositories. We don't send patches, test patches or the dataset itself. Is that consistent with rule 2.4.b?

Thanks!
